description: User report: at the start of the Fight phase the ka'tah window offered a unit that was out of combat. Codex: Adeptus Custodes (11e) DACATARAI / KAPTARIS are now offered only to readied units that can be in a fight this phase (the unit can pile in — engaged / charged / overrun — or an enemy within 6" can pile in). Fixture cus11e_c3_custodes_active, Custodes' own Fight phase. Setup privileges: the Telemon is moved into engagement with the Boyz (charged this turn); the Caladius is parked ~3" from the idle Gretchin (not engaged, nobody there can pile in). (1) The window offers the Telemon, not the Caladius. (2) A real click on Kaptaris for the Telemon; the re-opened window names 'Ka'tah already chosen: Telemon … — KAPTARIS' so the unit is not silently missing.

steps.script:
GameState.state.players["1"]["cp"] = 0
GameState.state.players["2"]["cp"] = 0
var b = GameState.state.units["U_BOYZ_B"].models[0].position
GameState.state.units["U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I"].models[0]["position"] = {"x": float(b.x) + 90.0, "y": float(b.y)}
GameState.state.units["U_TELEMON_HEAVY_DREADNOUGHT_I"].flags["charged_this_turn"] = true
var g = GameState.state.units["U_GRETCHIN_C"].models[0].position
GameState.state.units["U_CALADIUS_GRAV-TANK_E"].models[0]["position"] = {"x": float(g.x) + 420.0, "y": float(g.y)}
tree.current_scene._recreate_unit_visuals()
PhaseManager.transition_to_phase(10)
return true

steps.comment: the Caladius IS within 6" of an enemy (the old filter offered it)
the out-of-combat Caladius is not offered
re-opened for the other readied units in a fight
